profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Freddie Mac

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a new Java application with Java and Spring Boot to schedule travel itineraries around the world. Created the full workflow diagram. Designed the Oracle database schema and wrote SQL scripts. Wrote numerous Junits and Selenium tests for full end-to-end testing.
DevOps engineer work. Created Docker images for the Oracle Database and for Tomcat. Created and managed multiple Docker containers from the image, and have a Tomcat container communicate with its corresponding Oracle container via Docker network.
Managed Jenkins as admin. Created Jenkins pipeline scripts to build applications on a new Docker Tomcat container, then run Selenium tests on that new Docker Tomcat container. Scheduled the Jenkins pipelines in crontab as well.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Taking lead roles to create new modernized applications or convert legacy applications to modernized architectures. This includes converting legacy applications with monolithic layered web applications into a modern microservices and SOA (mostly REST web services and some SOAP web services) architectures. Convert and transfer relational databases and data into MongoDB (Big Data or NoSQL). Modernized the deployments of applications from web application servers to Kubernetes or Docker containers/pods managed with OpenShift. Utilized CI/CD and reduced deployment times by over 60% and application downtime during deployment by over 95%. Upgrade the front-end from outdated JSP pages to Angular, and integrate with the backend microservices architecture. Programmed UNIX Autosys jobs, crontab schedulers, and other schedulers.
Developed with Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Angular, Javascript, Typescript, Git, Maven, Gradle, Relational databases (Oracle and DB2), MongoDB (NoSQL or Big Data dataabase), Agile Scrum development methodology.
CI/CD deployments with Jenkins and OpenShift.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Web Applications developer
Server Development: Java 7, Spring 4, Struts, JSF 2, Tomcat, Weblogic, SQL, Oracle, Hibernate, JDBC, Database design, SOAP and REST based Web Services
Client Development: JavaScript, JQuery, AngularJS, JSP, AJAX, CSS, front end UI design and development
Software Management: Maven, Jenkins, Subversion, JIRA, Crucible
Developer Applications Used:  Eclipse, Netbeans, Intellij, Oracle SQL Developer

positions.title: Technology Related
positions.description:
Java Software Engineer (3 years)
Java, Struts, Java Server Faces, Eclipse, Hibernate, JSP, Javascript, AJAX, CSS, EXT-JS, Oracle

PHP and Dojo (1 year)
REST Server Web Services, AJAX, MySQL

Network Engineer and Systems Administration
UNIX Administrator, Windows Server 2003 Administrator, Configure workstations and servers to TCP/IP network, Web server administrator with Tomcat and JBOSS
